## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- WEDMPartRecognitionEngine.recognize — feature detection
- recognises a CIRCLE as a through-hole with correct diameter
- classifies a square closed polyline as a profile (aspect ≈ 1)
- classifies a thin rectangular closed polyline as a slot
- classifies a moderate aspect rectangle as a pocket
- classifies an OPEN polyline as a contour feature
